pins.title: Inside a Virginia Waterfront Cottage
pins.description: A look inside a 1940s cottage on a Chesapeake tidal creek: sleeping porch, screened dining porch over the water, green kitchen, and three bedrooms that sleep six.
pins.altText: The sleeping porch, a sunroom third bedroom with a brass daybed and windows on three sides.

pins.title: Screened Porch Living on the Chesapeake
pins.description: Two screened porches, one for dinner over the water and one for sleeping with the windows open. A waterfront cottage on Virginia's Northern Neck.
pins.altText: The screened dining porch set above a Chesapeake creek.

pins.title: Waterfront Cottage Interiors, Northern Neck Virginia
pins.description: Rattan, vintage rugs, deep green cabinets, and a window over the sink facing the creek. Inside a small waterfront cottage near Heathsville, Virginia.
pins.altText: The main bedroom at Captain's Cottage in soft natural light.
